recipes.name: Broccoli and Green Apple Juice
preparation: - Wash the broccoli thoroughly and cut it into pieces.
- Cut the apple in half and remove the seeds and core.
- Then place both ingredients in the blender and cover with the cup of water.
- Blend for a few minutes until you get a smooth, lump-free drink.
- Serve without straining.

recipes.name: Mango and Spinach Smoothie
preparation: - Wash the spinach leaves thoroughly and chop them.
- Place them in the blender along with the mango, pineapple, and water.
- Blend for a few minutes until everything is well combined.
- Serve and enjoy.

recipes.name: Green Tea, Cucumber and Pineapple Smoothie
preparation: - Add all the vegetables to the blender jar, including the ginger and avocado.
- Also add the pineapple, lemon juice, and green tea.
- Blend for a few moments until everything is well combined.
- Serve and enjoy immediately.

recipes.name: Green Tea, Pear and Orange Smoothie
preparation: - Place all the ingredients in the blender jar, including the almonds.
- Blend for a few minutes.
- Once you have a smooth, lump-free drink, serve it.

recipes.name: Grapefruit, Banana and Avocado Smoothie
preparation: - Squeeze the juice from the grapefruit and add it to the blender with the banana, avocado, and ginger.
- Then add the mint and water.
- Finally, blend until everything is well combined.

recipes.name: Melon, Kiwi and Apple Smoothie
preparation: - Cut all the fruits into pieces and place them in the blender along with the lemon and ice cubes.
- Blend until all the ingredients are well combined.
- Serve immediately, without straining.

recipes.name: Green Apple and Avocado Smoothie
preparation: - Cut the apple, avocado, and spinach into pieces.
- Then place them in the blender jar along with the water.
- Blend for a few seconds until all the ingredients are well combined.
- Serve and enjoy.

recipes.name: Green Coconut Smoothie
preparation: - Pour the coconut water and yogurt into the blender.
- Chop the spinach and banana, and add them to the rest of the ingredients.
- Blend for a few moments until you get a creamy, smooth drink.

recipes.name: Apple, Pineapple and Pear Smoothie
ingredient_description: Water, or a full glass if orange juice is not used
preparation: - Peel the apple, remove the core, and cut it into pieces.
- Cut the pineapple into pieces and remove the pear's core.
- Squeeze the juice from the orange.
- Place the apple, pineapple, and pear in the blender jar.
- Add the water and orange juice.
- Blend well and drink immediately.

recipes.name: Apple and Papaya Smoothie
preparation: - Cut the apple into quarters and remove the core. You can peel it if you like, though leaving the skin will give you more nutrients.
- Halve the papaya, remove the seeds and skin.
- Place the fruits in the blender.
- Add the water and honey if desired.
- Blend well and once you have a smooth cream, it is ready to drink.

recipes.name: Blackberry and Apple Smoothie
preparation: - Wash the apple and remove the core.
- Clean the blackberries thoroughly.
- In the blender jar, add the fruits, milk, and oats.
- Blend well and drink right away. If the result is too thick, add a little more water or milk.
Note: You can substitute the apple with strawberries if desired.

recipes.name: Papaya and Pineapple Smoothie
preparation: - Place the papaya and pineapple pulp, peeled and chopped, in the blender.
- Add the yogurt, coconut extract, and flaxseeds.
- If desired, you can add a little water or ice.
- Blend everything well and drink.

recipes.name: Pineapple, Orange and Plum Smoothie
preparation: - Peel and cut the pineapple slice.
- Wash the plums and remove the pits.
- Squeeze the oranges.
- Place the pineapple, plums, and orange juice in the blender.
- Add the flaxseeds.
- Blend until everything is well mixed and drink.

recipes.name: Banana and Blackberry Smoothie
preparation: - Peel the banana and slice it.
- Wash the blackberries well and halve the almonds.
- Place the fruits, almonds, and water or milk in the blender.
- Blend everything well and once you have a smooth mixture, enjoy it.

recipes.name: Lemon, Mango and Orange Smoothie
preparation: - Peel the mango and remove the pit. Cut the pulp and do the same with the orange.
- Squeeze the lemon juice.
- If you want to add the avocado, cut it into pieces.
- Place everything in the blender and blend well.
- Drink immediately.

recipes.name: Apple and Papaya Smoothie
preparation: - Cut the apple into quarters and remove the core. You can peel it if you like, though leaving the skin will give you more nutrients.
- Halve the papaya, remove the seeds and skin.
- Place the fruits in the blender.
- Add the water and honey if desired.
- Blend well and once you have a smooth cream, it is ready to drink.

recipes.name: Cabbage and Carrot Juice
preparation: - Cut the cabbage into pieces.
- Chop the carrots into small pieces.
- Cut each fennel head into 4 pieces.
- Place the vegetables in the blender along with the water.
- Blend well and drink immediately.

recipes.name: Banana, Strawberry and Pear Smoothie
preparation: - Cut all the ingredients into pieces.
- Add everything to the blender along with the water.
- Blend for a couple of minutes until everything is completely combined.
- Drink this juice in the mornings.

recipes.name: Pear and Oat Smoothie
preparation: - Cut the pear into pieces.
- Add the pear along with the oats and peppermint infusion to the blender.
- Blend for a few minutes until everything is combined.
- Finally, add honey to taste and drink.

recipes.name: Apple and Walnut Smoothie
preparation: - Remove the apple core and cut it into pieces.
- Blend the apple together with the almond milk.
- Add the walnuts and continue blending.
- Finally, add a little orange blossom honey and drink it nice and cold.

recipes.name: Spinach and Green Apple Smoothie
preparation: - Wash the spinach, apple, and cucumber well.
- Peel the lemon and cut all the ingredients into pieces.
- Place the ingredients in the blender along with the water.
- Blend until you get a smooth mixture.
- Strain the juice if you prefer a smoother texture, or drink as-is to get the full benefit of the fiber.
- Serve and consume immediately to get the most out of the nutrients.

recipes.name: Orange, Carrot and Ginger Juice
preparation: - Wash and peel the carrots well.
- Wash and peel the oranges, then cut them into pieces. Remove any seeds.
- Peel the ginger and cut a small piece.
- Place everything in the blender with the cup of water and blend for 2 or 3 minutes, or until smooth.
- Pour into a glass and drink.
- You can strain it or drink as-is to benefit from the fiber.

recipes.name: Beet, Apple and Carrot Juice
preparation: - Wash, peel, and cut the beet and carrot into pieces.
- Wash and cut the apple with the skin on, removing the core first.
- Place in the blender with a cup of water and blend until the mixture is smooth.
- Pour into a glass and drink, preferably without straining.

recipes.name: Blueberry and Banana Juice
preparation: - Wash the blueberries and peel the banana.
- Place in the blender with a cup of water.
- Blend until the mixture is smooth.
- Pour into a glass and drink immediately.

recipes.name: Melon and Apple Smoothie
ingredient_description: Small Apple or half a large one
preparation: - Remove the rind and seeds from the melon and wash the apple.
- Place both fruits in the blender along with the juice of half a lemon.
- Blend until smooth and homogeneous.
- If you prefer a thinner consistency, add a little more water.

recipes.name: Pineapple and Mango Smoothie
preparation: - Peel the pineapple and mango, and cut them into pieces.
- Place both fruits in the blender along with the water.
- Blend well until you get a smooth, homogeneous drink.

recipes.name: Cucumber and Red Berries Smoothie
ingredient_description: Red Berries (Strawberries, Raspberries, Blackberries or a mix)
preparation: - Wash all the ingredients and remove the green tops from the strawberries (if you chose them).
- Cut into roughly even pieces and place them in the blender.
- Add water and blend until you get a smooth texture.

recipes.name: Celery, Pear and Mint Smoothie
preparation: - Wash and chop the pear, celery stalks and mint.
- Blend them together in a blender.
- Add the water to help blend and obtain a lighter, diuretic smoothie.

recipes.name: Papaya and Banana Smoothie
preparation: - Remove the seeds from the papaya slice and cut it into several pieces.
- Then blend it in the blender with the banana and the glass of water.
- Process everything together until you get a smooth, homogeneous drink.

recipes.name: Grape and Blueberry Juice
preparation: - Wash all the fruits under a good stream of cold water.
- Place them in the blender or any kitchen appliance suitable for making smoothies.
- Add the water and blend until everything is well combined.

recipes.name: Orange and Carrot Juice
preparation: - Wash and peel the carrot, then peel the orange.
- Place both ingredients in the blender and add the water.
- Blend well until combined and you get a fairly smooth texture. Add more liquid to taste.

recipes.name: Spinach and Kiwi Smoothie
preparation: - Start by washing the spinach, drain slightly and place it in a blender.
- Peel the kiwi and add the flesh along with the spinach. Then squeeze the juice of half a lemon.
- Now blend everything together for a couple of minutes. Adjust the consistency with the water.

recipes.name: Lemon, Mango and Orange Smoothie
preparation: - Peel the mango and remove the pit. Cut the flesh and do the same with the orange.
- Squeeze the lemon juice.
- Place everything in the blender and blend well.
- Drink immediately.

recipes.name: Watermelon, Cherry and Pineapple Juice
preparation: - Pit the cherries.
- Remove the seeds from the watermelon and cut it into pieces along with the pineapple.
- Add everything to the blender along with the water and blend until well incorporated, then drink.

recipes.name: Beet, Orange and Parsley Juice
preparation: - Peel the beet and the oranges.
- Cut into pieces and add to the blender along with the parsley.
- Blend everything, adding water to reach your desired consistency.

recipes.name: Carrot and Celery Juice
preparation: - Wash the carrot and celery well, slice them and blend until you get a smooth, homogeneous mixture.
- Pour into a glass with ice and drink with any meal of the day, preferably unfiltered.

recipes.name: Orange, Cucumber, Parsley and Mandarin Juice
preparation: - Wash the cucumber well and slice it.
- Peel the orange and mandarin and cut them into cubes.
- Place all the ingredients in the blender and blend for 2 minutes or until you get a homogeneous mixture.
- Pour into a glass with ice and drink unfiltered.

recipes.name: Pineapple and Ginger Smoothie
preparation: - Blend all the ingredients for 2 minutes, or until you get a smooth, homogeneous mixture.
- Pour the smoothie into a glass with ice.
- Drink unfiltered.

recipes.name: Watermelon and Lemon Juice
preparation: - Place the watermelon, water and lemon juice in a blender and blend for 1 minute.
- Pour the juice into a glass with ice and drink immediately.

recipes.name: Passion Fruit and Cabbage Smoothie
preparation: - Wash and cut the cabbage leaf into pieces.
- Place the passion fruit pulp along with the cabbage in a blender.
- Blend for 2 to 3 minutes or until you get a smooth consistency.
- Pour the juice into a glass and drink, preferably unfiltered.

recipes.name: Beet and Carrot Juice
preparation: - Wash and peel all the ingredients; for the apple, remove the core.
- Cut everything into pieces and place in the blender along with the lemon juice.
- Blend until you get a homogeneous mixture.
- You can strain the juice or drink it as is, and add ice to taste.

recipes.name: Pineapple, Spinach and Celery Juice
preparation: - Wash, peel and chop the pineapple and cucumber.
- Wash the spinach and celery well and cut them into pieces.
- Blend all the ingredients until you get a smooth, homogeneous mixture.
- Serve in a glass, straining if you prefer.

recipes.name: Orange, Pomegranate and Ginger Juice
preparation: - Squeeze the juice from the oranges, avoiding the seeds.
- Remove the seeds from the pomegranate.
- Peel the ginger and finely chop the small piece.
- Blend all the ingredients with a cup of water until fully combined.
- Serve in a glass; you can strain the mixture if desired.

recipes.name: Grape and Apple Smoothie
preparation: - Wash the grapes well and cut the apple into small cubes, first removing the core.
- Add all the ingredients to the blender and blend for a few moments.
- Once you get a smooth, homogeneous drink, serve it unfiltered.
- Consume immediately, as fruit oxidizes quickly and sitting too long can spoil it.
- Enjoy this drink on an empty stomach or mid-morning.

recipes.name: Kiwi, Orange and Spinach Smoothie
preparation: - Peel the kiwi and cut it into several pieces.
- Then blend everything in the blender with the orange juice, spinach and ice.
- Enjoy as soon as you prepare it.

recipes.name: Raspberry and Melon Smoothie
preparation: - Wash the raspberries well, and cut the melon slices.
- Pour all the ingredients into the blender and process until you get a smooth, homogeneous drink.
- Serve immediately, unfiltered.

recipes.name: Avocado, Banana and Ginger Smoothie
preparation: - Peel and chop the banana and avocado.
- Place the fruits in the blender and blend with the coconut water.
- Once ready, add the pinch of ginger.
- Serve well chilled and enjoy.

recipes.name: Guava and Orange Smoothie
preparation: - Peel both fruits well. Then remove the seeds from the oranges and trim any white pith.
- Place the chopped fruits in the blender with the coconut milk.
- Blend for a few moments until you get a creamy, homogeneous smoothie.
- Serve unfiltered and enjoy.

recipes.name: Green Apple, Cucumber and Celery Smoothie
preparation: - Chop the cucumber and add it to the blender with the apple, celery and water.
- Process for a few moments until you get a smooth, homogeneous drink.
- Consume immediately.

recipes.name: Cucumber and Blueberry Smoothie
preparation: - Chop the cucumber and add it to the blender with the blueberries, spinach and yogurt.
- Process everything until you get a creamy, homogeneous drink.
- Serve with ice and enjoy.

recipes.name: Mango and Avocado Smoothie
preparation: - Cut the ripe mango and avocado into cubes.
- Put everything in the blender with the yogurt and ice.
- Process until you get a creamy, homogeneous smoothie.

recipes.name: Red Berries and Kale Smoothie
preparation: - Wash the red berries well and blend them with the rest of the ingredients.
- Make sure to process until everything is well combined.
- Consume immediately.

recipes.name: Banana, Green Tea and Pineapple Smoothie
preparation: - Chop the ripe bananas and pineapple.
- Wash the spinach and add all the ingredients to the blender.
- Blend for a couple of minutes until everything is well combined.
- Serve and enjoy immediately.

recipes.name: Carrot, Ginger and Turmeric Smoothie
preparation: - Chop the frozen banana and place it in the blender with the rest of the ingredients, except the lemon juice.
- Blend for a few moments until you get a creamy, homogeneous drink.
- If desired, add the lemon juice when serving for a citrusy touch.
- Consume immediately.

recipes.name: Aloe Vera, Kiwi and Banana Smoothie
preparation: - Pour the aloe vera gel, chopped banana and peeled, sliced kiwis into the blender.
- Add the coconut water and blend for a few moments.
- Once everything is fully combined, serve unfiltered.
Note: Before extracting the aloe vera, remember to soak the plant leaf in a jar of water to drain its aloin.

recipes.name: Protein Smoothie with Mango and Chia
preparation: - Place all ingredients in a blender.
- Blend until smooth and lump-free.
- Serve and consume immediately after your workout.

recipes.name: Banana and Oat Smoothie
preparation: - Place all ingredients in a blender.
- Blend until smooth, achieving a uniform and homogeneous texture that is pleasant to drink.
- Enjoy at room temperature or with ice to refresh yourself after each workout.

recipes.name: Protein, Chocolate and Almond Smoothie
preparation: - Use a blender to mix all the ingredients.
- Blend until smooth and homogeneous.
- Drink it before your workout sessions.

recipes.name: Protein and Oat Smoothie
preparation: - Pour all ingredients into a blender.
- Blend until you reach a texture you enjoy.
- Drink immediately.

recipes.name: Walnut and Banana Smoothie
preparation: - Add all ingredients to a blender.
- Blend everything until smooth and homogeneous.
- You can add ice if you like.
- Drink it after your workout to refresh yourself.

recipes.name: Protein Smoothie with Peach
preparation: - Place all ingredients in a blender.
- Blend until completely smooth and homogeneous.
- Drink immediately after each workout.

recipes.name: Egg and Oat Smoothie
preparation: - Add all ingredients to a blender.
- Blend until well combined and smooth.
- You can add ice if you like.
- Drink it immediately after every workout.

recipes.name: Protein and Mixed Berry Smoothie
ingredient_description: Mixed Berries (strawberries, blueberries, raspberries or blackberries)
preparation: - Combine the berries, milk, protein powder and chia seeds in a blender.
- Add ice and honey if desired.
- Blend until smooth and homogeneous.
- Serve immediately and enjoy.

recipes.name: Raspberry, Apple and Orange Juice
preparation: - Peel the apple and cut it into pieces.
- Add the apple and raspberries to the blender and blend everything together.
- Squeeze the oranges, strain the juice, add it to the blender and continue blending.
- If needed, add a little water.
- Strain the juice to remove the raspberry seeds and it's ready.
- Drink on an empty stomach for one week. Pair with a healthy diet.

recipes.name: Carrot and Green Apple Juice
preparation: - Wash, peel and chop the carrots.
- Wash the apples thoroughly and slice them. You can leave the skin on as it is beneficial for the body.
- Wash the spinach thoroughly.
- Place everything in the blender and blend. You can also add the juice of one lemon if desired.
- Add the necessary amount of water and some crushed ice to serve the juice nice and cold.
- Drink one glass on an empty stomach for one or two weeks.

recipes.name: Melon and Kiwi Juice
preparation: - Peel the kiwis and slice them.
- Remove the seeds and rind from the melon and dice the flesh.
- Add the fruits to the blender, squeeze in the lemon juice and blend well.
- Add the necessary amount of water and serve cold.
- Drink every morning on an empty stomach for one or two weeks, and in smaller amounts between meals to help stay full.

recipes.name: Blueberry and Pineapple Juice
preparation: - Squeeze the orange and set the juice aside.
- Chop the pineapple and rinse the blueberries thoroughly.
- Place the above ingredients into the blender and blend everything together.
- Add the water and crushed ice if desired.
- Drink two glasses daily: one on an empty stomach and another half an hour before lunch.
- Maintain a healthy diet.

recipes.name: Lemon and Parsley Juice
preparation: - Squeeze the juice from the lemons and pour it into the blender.
- Wash the parsley and add it to the blender.
- Blend and add the necessary amount of water and ice.
- Drink on an empty stomach and wait half an hour before having a healthy, balanced breakfast.

recipes.name: Orange, Carrot and Ginger Juice
preparation: - Wash and peel the carrots thoroughly.
- Wash and peel the oranges and cut them into pieces. Avoid the seeds.
- Peel the ginger and cut a small piece.
- Place everything in the blender along with the cup of water and blend for 2 to 3 minutes or until smooth.
- Pour into a glass and drink.
- You can strain it or drink as is to take advantage of the fiber.
- Drink one glass mid-morning and another in the afternoon for a maximum of 10 consecutive days.

recipes.name: Strawberry, Beet and Ginger Juice
preparation: - Wash the strawberries and chop them.
- Chop the beet, add it to the blender and add the strawberries.
- Add the peeled and chopped ginger and blend.
- Pour in the water and continue blending.
- Consume on an empty stomach and maintain a balanced diet.

recipes.name: Grape and Apple Cider Vinegar Juice
preparation: - Wash the grapes and place them in the blender.
- Add the vinegar and blend.
- Add the water, continue blending, then strain the juice to remove any remaining grape seeds.
- Drink 3 glasses of this juice over 7 days: the first on an empty stomach and the rest half an hour before each meal.

recipes.name: Pineapple, Green Apple and Chia Juice
preparation: - Peel the pineapple, remove the core and cut into slices.
- Wash and chop the apples and add them to the blender along with the pineapple.
- Blend and add the orange juice or water.
- Add the chia seeds and stir to combine.
- Consume on an empty stomach half an hour before breakfast.

recipes.name: Pineapple and Celery Juice
preparation: - Wash the celery and slice it.
- Chop the pineapple and add it to the blender.
- Add the celery and blend everything together.
- Add the necessary amount of water and ice to serve the juice nice and cold.
- Consume on an empty stomach 3 days a week.

recipes.name: Pear and Apple Juice
preparation: - Wash the fruits well, peel them and add them to a blender.
- Add the brewer's yeast and a pinch of cinnamon.
- Then add the water and serve with ice to taste.
- Drink it slowly — the juice refreshes and relieves pain.

recipes.name: Mango, Strawberry and Watermelon Juice
preparation: - Start by grinding the walnuts, then wash and cut the fruits into small pieces.
- Place the strawberries, watermelon, mango and ground walnuts in the blender.
- Add the water and blend until smooth.
- If desired, you can add a tablespoon of honey.
- These ingredients relieve discomfort and help prevent dizziness.

recipes.name: Carrot Juice
preparation: - Wash the carrots and celery thoroughly, then squeeze the oranges and the half lemon.
- Place all the ingredients in the blender and blend well until smooth.
- Its aroma and freshness are immediately noticeable, making it a purifying and relaxing remedy.

recipes.name: Cucumber, Green Apple and Ginger Juice
preparation: - Wash all the ingredients thoroughly.
- Cut them into pieces and place in the blender with the water, preferably cold.
- Blend for 2 to 3 minutes or until smooth.
- Pour into a glass and consume immediately.

recipes.name: Carrot, Melon and Cucumber Juice
preparation: - Wash all the ingredients, chop them into pieces and place in the blender along with the lemon juice and water.
- Blend until smooth.
- Pour into a glass and drink right away, slowly and preferably cold.

recipes.name: Orange, Blueberry and Ginger Juice
preparation: - First, squeeze the juice from both oranges using a juicer.
- It is better if you keep the fibers.
- Pour the juice into the blender with the blueberries, ginger, and milk.
- Blend everything until you get a smooth, lump-free mixture.
- You can refrigerate it or add ice before drinking.
- Consume no more than once a day. Consult your doctor first.

recipes.name: Papaya and Strawberry Smoothie
preparation: - Peel the papaya and cut it into slices that are not too thick.
- Wash and drain the strawberries well.
- Once you have the ingredients, place them in the blender jar.
- Blend for a couple of minutes until well combined.
- You can have this smoothie as part of your breakfast; we recommend drinking it once a day.
- Consult your doctor.
NOTE: Choose a low-fat yogurt with no added sugar. You can replace it with skim milk or water if you prefer a lower-calorie smoothie.

recipes.name: Spinach, Green Apple and Cucumber Smoothie
preparation: - Wash the spinach, apple, and cucumber well.
- Cut all ingredients into pieces.
- Place the ingredients in the blender along with the water.
- Blend until you get a smooth mixture.
- Strain the juice if you prefer a smoother texture, or drink as is to keep the fiber.
- Serve and consume immediately to get the most nutrients.
- You can drink it 2 to 3 times per week. Consult your doctor.

recipes.name: Green Apple, Tomato and Parsley Smoothie
preparation: - Wash, drain, and slice the apples and tomatoes. Leave the skin on.
- Remove the core from the apples.
- Then wash, drain, and finely chop the parsley.
- Put all ingredients in the blender and process.
- Drink immediately; you can have it 3 times per week.
- Consult your doctor first.

recipes.name: Kiwi, Green Apple and Spinach Smoothie
preparation: - Peel the kiwi and cut it into slices.
- Wash and julienne the apple, remove the core but leave the skin.
- Place all ingredients in the blender and process until fully combined.
- Once ready, let it cool and consume 2 to 3 times per week.
- Consult your doctor.

recipes.name: Oat and Raspberry Smoothie
preparation: - Wash the raspberries and place them in the blender.
- Add the oats and milk.
- Blend until everything is well combined.
- Drink cold once a day.
- Consult your doctor.

recipes.name: Green Smoothie with Carrot
preparation: - Start by washing and chopping all ingredients.
- Then place them in a blender and process until you get a smooth drink.
- Drink cold, 2 times per week.
- Consult your doctor.

recipes.name: Kiwi, Banana and Green Apple Smoothie
preparation: - First wash and chop the apples.
- Then peel the kiwi and banana, and cut them into small pieces.
- Place all ingredients in a blender and process until there are no large fruit chunks.
- Enjoy this drink once per week.
- Consult your doctor.

recipes.name: Nopal Smoothie
preparation: - To make this smoothie, first wash the nopal, remove the spines, and cut it into pieces.
- Place it in a blender, add the lemon juice and water.
- Finally, blend everything thoroughly before drinking. You can have 1 glass per day.
- Consult your doctor.

recipes.name: Pomegranate Smoothie
preparation: - First cut the pomegranates in half.
- Then, using a juicer, extract the juice until you fill a glass.
- Finally, drink 1 glass per day.
- Consult your doctor.

recipes.name: Tomato, Cucumber and Carrot Smoothie
preparation: - First wash and chop the cucumber, tomatoes, and carrot.
- Then place them in a blender along with the parsley and half a glass of water.
- Process all ingredients until you get a smooth mixture.
- Drink the smoothie freshly made.
- Have it at least 3 times per week.

recipes.name: Pineapple, Grapefruit and Spinach Smoothie
preparation: - First extract the juice from the grapefruit.
- Then put it in the blender and combine with the pineapple, spinach leaves, and half a glass of water.
- Process everything for a few seconds until well combined and smooth.
- You can drink it every day on an empty stomach.

recipes.name: Carrot and Spinach Smoothie
preparation: - Wash and disinfect all ingredients.
- Process everything in the blender until you get a smooth juice, adding water until it reaches the desired consistency.
- Drink on an empty stomach without straining, at least 3 times per week.

recipes.name: Kiwi, Spinach and Lettuce Smoothie
preparation: - Peel and wash the kiwi, spinach leaves, and lettuce leaves.
- Then put them in a blender with the glass of water.
- Process for a few seconds until you get a smooth mixture.
- Drink fresh, preferably on an empty stomach.

recipes.name: Oat and Apple Smoothie
preparation: - Place the oats in a container with water and let them soak overnight.
- The next day, drain them and put them in the blender along with the apple, previously washed, peeled, and cut into pieces.
- In the blender, add the water or milk along with the other ingredients and blend until smooth.
- Serve the smoothie and enjoy during breakfast or at any time of day.

recipes.name: Papaya, Flaxseed, Lemon and Spinach Smoothie
ingredient_description: Oatmeal cooked with unsweetened almond milk
preparation: - Place in a blender the papaya, flaxseed, previously washed spinach, and the juice of half a lemon.
- Blend for a few seconds then add the cooked oatmeal.
- Blend until you get a smooth, lump-free mixture.
- Serve and enjoy 2 times per week.

recipes.name: Apple and Papaya Smoothie
preparation: - Quarter the apple and remove the core. You can peel it if you like, though leaving the skin on will give you more nutrients.
- Halve the papaya, remove the seeds and skin.
- Place the fruits in the blender.
- Add the water and honey if desired.
- Blend well and once you get a smooth cream, it is ready to drink.
- Drink one or two glasses per day.

recipes.name: Ginkgo Biloba Juice
preparation: - Wash all ingredients.
- First blend the celery with the pineapple and ginger, add the water and honey, and the ginkgo extract.
- Place the fruits in the blender.
- Blend again until fully combined.
- Serve and drink immediately.

recipes.name: Watercress and Spinach Juice
preparation: - Wash the watercress, spinach, and lettuce thoroughly under running water.
- Place the vegetables in the blender jar along with the carrot juice.
- Process for a few seconds.
- Add the tablespoons of oats and blend into the mixture.
- Serve and drink this juice on an empty stomach until you feel the hemorrhoids have gone away.

recipes.name: Cucumber and Alfalfa Juice
preparation: - Wash the alfalfa well to remove all dirt.
- Wash the cucumber and peel it.
- Add the vegetables with the rest of the ingredients.
- Process until you get a smooth mixture.
- Serve and drink daily in the mornings.

recipes.name: Turnip and Watercress Juice
preparation: - Wash and chop the watercress and turnips.
- Add to the blender and blend for a few seconds or until the mixture is well combined.
- Serve and drink freshly made.
- You can drink a glass daily for fifteen days alongside a diet rich in liquids and fiber.

recipes.name: Banana, Ginger and Lemon Juice
preparation: - Cut and squeeze the lemon, making sure not to leave seeds in the liquid.
- Strain and peel the ginger and banana.
- Blend everything with the water for 60 seconds.
- Consume immediately.

recipes.name: Papaya and Chia Seed Smoothie
preparation: - Place the chia seeds in a cup covered with water and wait 6 to 8 hours for them to hydrate.
- Place all ingredients in a blender jar and process until you get a smooth mixture.
- Serve and consume immediately.

recipes.name: Oat and Apple Smoothie
preparation: - Place the oats in a container with water and let them soak overnight.
- The next day, drain them and put them in the blender along with the apple, previously washed, peeled, and cut into pieces.
- In the blender, add the water or milk along with the other ingredients and blend until smooth.
- Serve the smoothie and enjoy during breakfast or at any time of day.

recipes.name: Pear and Chia Seed Smoothie
preparation: - Leave the chia seeds in a container covered with water for 6 to 8 hours to hydrate.
- Wash, peel, and core the pears, then cut them into pieces.
- Blend everything for 40 seconds or until you reach a smooth consistency.
- Drink immediately.

recipes.name: Mango and Turmeric Smoothie
preparation: - Peel the cucumber and cut into chunks.
- Peel the mango, remove the pit and cut into chunks.
- Pour the coconut water into the blender with all ingredients except the mango, and blend for 5 seconds.
- Add the mango and blend until smooth.
- You can garnish with mango chunks and fennel.

recipes.name: Banana and Blackberry Smoothie
preparation: - Peel the banana and slice it.
- Wash the blackberries well and halve the almonds.
- Place the fruits, almonds, and water or milk in the blender.
- Blend everything well until smooth and enjoy.
- You can add ice at the end and garnish with cinnamon.

recipes.name: Carrot, Orange and Parsley Smoothie
preparation: - Trim the ends of the carrots and break up the parsley sprigs.
- Add the carrots to the blender along with the remaining ingredients.
- Blend for 90 seconds and strain.
- Serve and enjoy.

recipes.name: Banana and Cinnamon Smoothie
preparation: - Peel the banana and cut it into slices.
- Add all ingredients to the blender and process until smooth.
- You can add cocoa powder if desired.
- Drink immediately.

recipes.name: Pineapple, Spinach and Ginger Smoothie
preparation: - Place everything in a blender or food processor and blend until completely smooth.
- Add ice to taste if needed.
- Pour into a glass and enjoy.

recipes.name: Soda, Lemon and Ginger Juice
preparation: - Add ice to a glass.
- Grate the ginger and add it to the glass along with the lemon juice.
- Add a pinch of salt.
- Add the soda water, preferably very cold.
- Drink slowly.

recipes.name: Tomato Juice
preparation: - Add the tomato to a blender, then add one cup of water.
- Also add a pinch of salt and pepper.
- Blend and serve in a glass with ice.
- Once in the glass, add a splash of lemon.

recipes.name: Tomato, Cucumber and Onion Juice
preparation: - First wash all the ingredients and then place them in the blender.
- Add the half glass of water and the olive oil.
- Blend at maximum speed until everything is fully combined.
- Consume before going to bed and again in the morning.
- It may not have the most pleasant taste; however, its diuretic and cleansing properties make it one of the best remedies for alcohol intoxication.

recipes.name: Banana and Orange Smoothie
preparation: - Peel the banana and cut it into slices.
- Blend the banana together with the orange juice — use freshly squeezed.
- Consume the juice preferably on an empty stomach when you wake up.

recipes.name: Carrot and Citrus Juice
preparation: - Wash all the ingredients well.
- Squeeze the juice from the orange and lemon and pour into the blender along with the carrot, cut into pieces.
- Process for a few moments until you get a smooth drink.
- Consume before going to bed and again in the morning when you wake up.

recipes.name: Kiwi and Strawberry Smoothie
preparation: - Peel the kiwis, wash the strawberries well and cut all the fruit into pieces.
- Place everything in the blender.
- Add 1/2 glass of water and ice to taste, then blend for a few moments until everything is combined.
- Consume on an empty stomach and again mid-morning.

recipes.name: Orange, Beet and Carrot Juice
preparation: - Wash and peel all ingredients.
- Then chop the beet, celery and carrot.
- Squeeze the orange juice and place everything in the blender with half a glass of water.
- Blend at maximum speed for a few moments until you get a smooth drink.
- Drink before going to bed and again when you wake up in the morning.

recipes.name: Citrus, Honey and Oat Smoothie
preparation: - Blend the orange juice with the lemon juice, strawberries, guavas and pineapple for 3 minutes or until fully combined.
- Add the honey and mix well.
- Serve and garnish with oats.

recipes.name: Orange, Lemon and Propolis Smoothie
preparation: - Squeeze all the citrus fruits and add the propolis.
- Ideally consume it in the morning.

recipes.name: Apple and Honey Smoothie
preparation: - Wash and cut the apples into chunks.
- Blend the apples with the glass of water, then add the juice of half a lemon at the end.
- Consume right away, in the morning and at night.

recipes.name: Pineapple, Strawberry and Guava Smoothie
preparation: - Wash and cut all the fruit into pieces.
- Place in the blender and blend together with the two cups of orange juice and the lemon juice.
- Process for 3 minutes.
- Once you have a smooth mixture, pour into a glass and enjoy.

recipes.name: Orange and Carrot Juice
preparation: - Wash and peel the carrot. Then peel the orange.
- Place both ingredients in the blender and add the water.
- Blend well until combined and fairly smooth in texture. Add more liquid to taste.

recipes.name: Pineapple, Orange and Ginger Juice
preparation: - Place all ingredients in the blender.
- Blend for 3 minutes.
- Pour into a glass and enjoy.

recipes.name: Lemon and Papaya Juice
preparation: - Peel and chop the papaya.
- Place the chopped papaya in the blender and add the remaining ingredients.
- Blend until smooth and lump-free.
- You can add half a tablespoon of honey and 4 mint leaves when serving.

recipes.name: Beet and Lemon Juice
preparation: - Wash, peel and cut the beet into pieces. Bring to a boil.
- Once cooked, allow to cool completely.
- Squeeze the lemon juice and remove the seeds.
- Place all ingredients in the blender, add ice and blend until smooth.

recipes.name: Banana and Turmeric Juice
preparation: - Peel the bananas, slice them and place in the blender.
- Peel the ginger and add it to the blender.
- Add the remaining ingredients and blend.
- Serve and enjoy.

recipes.name: Grapefruit, Lemon and Orange Juice
preparation: - Add all ingredients to the blender or food processor.
- Blend and, if needed, add 1/2 glass of water to thin out.
- Drink freshly made, preferably on an empty stomach to get the most benefit.

recipes.name: Orange and Ginger Juice
preparation: - Blend all ingredients in a blender or food processor.
- Drink the juice freshly made.
- You can prepare it before bedtime for 3 consecutive nights.
- For a deep cleanse, take it for 7 consecutive nights.

recipes.name: Apple and Lemon Juice
preparation: - Wash the apples, peel them and cut into pieces.
- Add to the blender together with the lemon juice.
- Process until everything is well combined.
- Drink this juice on an empty stomach for 7 consecutive days.

recipes.name: Carrot, Lemon and Ginger Juice
preparation: - Peel the carrots and blend them with the water.
- Squeeze the lemon and add the juice to the carrots.
- Add the ginger and honey, and stir until fully combined.
- Drink on an empty stomach for 7 days.

recipes.name: Aloe Vera and Pineapple Smoothie
preparation: - Extract the gel from the aloe vera leaf.
- Place the gel, pineapple and water in the blender.
- Blend well until smooth.
- Drink this juice in the morning on an empty stomach.
- Although aloe vera has notable benefits for the body, this juice is not recommended for pregnant or breastfeeding women.
Note: Before extracting the aloe vera, remember to soak the plant leaf in a jar of water to drain its aloin.

recipes.name: Apple and Carrot Juice
preparation: - Wash and cut the apples and carrots into small pieces.
- Place the apples, carrots and water in a blender.
- Blend until smooth.
- Drink this juice once a day.

recipes.name: Ginger and Lemon Juice
preparation: - Grate the ginger and squeeze the lemon juice.
- Mix the grated ginger, lemon juice and warm water.
- Blend for 3 minutes and drink this juice in the morning on an empty stomach.

recipes.name: Orange, Blueberry and Pineapple Juice
preparation: - Place all washed and peeled ingredients in the blender.
- Blend until smooth.
- Serve immediately.

recipes.name: Apple and Mango Smoothie
preparation: - Place all ingredients in the blender.
- Blend until smooth and lump-free.
- Serve immediately.

recipes.name: Green Apple, Pear, Kiwi and Celery Smoothie
preparation: - Place all ingredients in the blender.
- Blend until smooth.
- Serve and drink immediately.

recipes.name: Watermelon and Strawberry Smoothie
preparation: - Place all ingredients in the blender.
- Blend until smooth.
- Serve and drink immediately.

recipes.name: Blueberry and Spinach Smoothie
preparation: - Place all ingredients in a blender.
- Blend until completely smooth.
- Serve and drink immediately.

recipes.name: Carrot and Parsley Juice
preparation: - Start by washing, peeling and cutting the carrots into pieces.
- Place them in the blender.
- Add the parsley and a glass of water.
- Blend until well mixed. If too thick, adjust the consistency with a little more water.

recipes.name: Apple, Celery and Spinach Juice
preparation: - Wash the celery, spinach and apple thoroughly.
- Peel the apple.
- Cut into pieces and transfer to the blender.
- Add the water.
- Blend everything well until smooth.
- Serve and drink immediately.

recipes.name: Papaya Juice
preparation: - Peel the papaya, remove the seeds and cut into cubes.
- Blend with the water until smooth.
- Serve and enjoy immediately.

recipes.name: Banana and Pear Smoothie
preparation: - Start by peeling and cutting the fruit into roughly equal pieces.
- Combine all ingredients in a blender until smooth.
- Serve and drink immediately.

recipes.name: Apple and Coconut Water Smoothie
preparation: - Clean, peel and core the apple, then cut into pieces.
- Blend the apple and coconut water until completely smooth.
- Serve and enjoy.

recipes.name: Aloe Vera and Papaya Juice
preparation: - Place all ingredients in a food processor or blender.
- Blend until smooth.
- Drink once ready.
- Although aloe vera has notable benefits for the body, this juice is not recommended for pregnant or breastfeeding women.
Note: Before extracting the aloe vera, remember to soak the plant leaf in a jar of water to drain its aloin.

recipes.name: Cabbage Juice
preparation: - Wash the cabbage and cut it in half.
- Blend with the water or almond milk.
- Serve and consume immediately.

recipes.name: Avocado and Mango Juice
preparation: - Peel the mango and avocado, remove the pit and pour the pulp into the blender.
- Blend everything with the water or milk until smooth.
- Pour into a glass and add a pinch of cinnamon to taste.
